## Page 9

Business Highlights in 2025
Maintained operational resilience despite external pressures 
Performance Overview
•
 Sales and Net Profit declined 13% and 17% YoY, primarily due to U.S. Tariffs, FX volatility, demand slowdown and delays in realizing new businesses. 
•
 Profitability  remained resilient, with net profit margin at ~4%  through operational efficiency and cost discipline.
• Performance improved during the year , narrowing the gap from ~30% in 1H to the mid -teens decline by year -end.
Business Segment Performance
•  Consumable Packaging:  Impacted by U.S. tariffs in 1H2025 but recovered in 2H, helping narrow the gap. 
•  Flexible Packaging:  Growth in target markets and new customer wins helped offset domestic slowdown 
•  Paper Packaging:  Continued focus on strategic sourcing savings while gradually converting pipeline opportunities into new sales
Strategic Execution
•  Operational efficiency and raw material cost optimization  helped mitigate margin pressure.
•  ESG progress on track , with ~70% of initiatives fully implemented.
•  SAP S/4HANA implementation underway , consolidating multiple ERP systems across the group into a single platform by 2026  to enhance   
    efficiency and data integration.
Risk Management
• Geopolitical developments, global trade dynamics, and FX volatility remain key risks.
• Active risk management through hedging, diversified sourcing, and disciplined cost control

Key Drivers
WTI Crude Oil
Global crude oil prices softened over  the past 12 months, 
peaking at USD 79.01 , bottom at USD 54.82 and closing at 
USD 57.00. Lower crude  oil prices helped ease upstream 
cost pressure. However, ongoing high volatility remains a 
key risk.
Resin Price
Resin prices declined gradually throughout 2025 , partially 
helped offset overall product cost pressure. However , this 
also intensified customer pressure for price reductions, 
limiting margin gains.
FX (USD/THB)
The USD/THB exchange rate fluctuated with an appreciation 
trend, ranging from ~ 34.6 to ~30.9 THB /USD. This supported 
lower imported raw material costs but also pressured export 
competitiveness.

## Page 18

Outlook, Opportunities and Challenges 2026 
US Tariff Clarity:  
•  Th
e US supreme court’s judgement on reciprocal tariffs reshapes the tariff landscape. 
•  The global tariff level of 15% is more favorable for our US customers compared with the previous 19%.
Raw Materials & Costs:
     •  Petrochemical supply chains remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
     • We have secured supply contracts for key resin grades and maintain sufficient safety stock, while sourcing substitutable  
        materials where possible.
Sustainability & Compliance:
•  Stricter plastic regulations are driving demand for bio -based and recyclable packaging.
•  However, higher product costs and customer price sensitivity continue to slow the adoption of green solutions.
Market Demand & Growth:
•  Geopolitical uncertainty continues to affect global demand visibility.
•  Demand is expected to gradually normalize once geopolitical tensions ease.
Financial & FX:
•  THB/USD volatility requires continued monitoring and hedging.
•  Lower interest rate trends may help ease financing costs
